description: MCP server for Loomio (loomio.com and self-hosted instances). 12 tools (8 read, 4 write) covering discussions, polls, comments, group memberships (any member lists the roster; emails only where the connector's user is a group admin), per-discussion event streams, and per-user activity analysis via Loomio's b2 public API (auth: Authorization: Bearer). Plus 2 opt-in instance-admin tools (deactivate / reactivate user) on the b3 namespace, gated by LOOMIO_B3_API_KEY. Read-only mode via LOOMIO_MCP_READONLY=1 advertises only the 8 read tools — Cloud Run deployments default to this; local stdio enables writes. Every tool carries the full MCP ToolAnnotations set: reads are readOnlyHint + idempotentHint so clients can auto-approve them, and destructive writes (manage_memberships with remove_absent, deactivate_user) carry destructiveHint so clients prompt before invocation. Tested against Loomio 3.8.1; classifies Loomio's 403 bodies (rotated key vs. missing role vs. WAF), probes key health at startup and on GET /health (HTTP transport). Known limitation: list_events / get_user_activity fail with a clear error on Loomio >= 3.4.0, which removed the v1/events endpoint (port to b2 thread items planned).
